ns2:course.label: Junior Planning Workshop
ns2:course.description: Introduction to planning practice, with an emphasis on physical planning skills. Includes field observation, spatial data analysis, professional communication, and design. Prerequisite: UP 205, UP 312, UP 260 and UP 316.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: UP 205, UP 312, UP 260 and UP 316.
